review.assessment: The diff adds a new `solution.ts` that implements a naive split-based parser iterating over `&`-separated pairs and splitting each on `=`. This implementation completely lacks the required real-query-string behaviors: it overwrites duplicate keys instead of collecting them into arrays, performs no URL decoding for `%xx` or `+`, does not strip a leading `?`, maps bare keys to `undefined` instead of an empty string, and returns `{ "": undefined }` on empty input rather than `{}`.

findings.defect: Repeated keys overwrite the previous value instead of collecting them into an array.
No percent-decoding or `+`-to-space conversion is performed.
Empty input returns a single key with an undefined value instead of an empty object.
Bare keys (no `=`) are assigned `undefined` instead of an empty string.
A leading `?` is not stripped; it becomes part of the first key.
